chrome.reference: Native Chrome DOM getBBox plus independent Canvas Path2D paints; pinned WPT reference SVGs

visualReview.observation: Only the top green rectangle boundary differs numerically; actual introduces blue into a row where native SVG has none.

conclusion: A blue rectangle geometrically outside a slice viewport still contributes one antialiased row at fractional output scaling. Removing that clipped rectangle makes native, fallback, factory-throws and native SVG pixels exact. 256 and 1024 output sizes are exact; 1170 is not.
caution: The oversized-green mutation also changes native edge antialiasing relative to the hand-reduced reference. Use its svgRGBAError against its own native SVG for that control, not its rgbaError against the unchanged hand reference.
next: Construct four-edge touch/just-outside/just-inside controls with fill, stroke, transforms and animation.
Inspect conservative visibility culling or geometric clipping before rasterization; do not erase real stroke coverage or change pixel tolerances.
Verify native SVG pixels and both native-Path2D/fallback rendering paths; WeChat/physical device evidence remains separate.
Stabilize first-case native SVG animation readiness before certifying animation controls; existing frozenSource exposes the stale y=0 oracle.
